name: Sunset chapter
description: A slatted synthwave sun, yellow to orange to red, sinks into the gutter of an open book whose night-blue pages carry the violet laser grid.
choices: The outrun horizon becomes the top edge of the pages, and the floor grid recedes toward the gutter
No sky, palm trees or chrome lettering: just the sun and the book
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
